name: mail-adagio
description: Sorts Gmail: gives each mail one theme and one status, using an AI model you choose. Never deletes mail.
status: Steps 1-2: read-only. Reads and classifies, changes nothing in Gmail yet.
how_to_call: python adagio.py call   (one JSON request on stdin, one JSON result on stdout)

input.limit: preview only: number of recent mails (default 20)
input.since_days: preview only: only mails from the last N days (optional)

preview.fallbacks: mails the model could not classify
preview.mails: [{uid, gm_msgid, date, sender, subject, existing_labels, theme, status, classified}] Important first
